instruction: Go to the NFL videos page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the videos page. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify the active tab URL matches https://www.nfl.com/videos. Simple navigation with similar difficulty to original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single instruction requirement: reaching the NFL videos page
Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' properly compares actual URL against expected URL using compare_urls function
Expected value 'https://www.nfl.com/videos' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Correct parameter handling: When expected.type='rule', get_rule returns rules dict directly, and metric correctly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url']
No postconfig needed - URL state persists in browser after navigation
Complete coverage: Instruction has one requirement (navigate to videos page), evaluator checks exactly that
